links.outcome: Exam score of general LLMs on specialist certification practice exam
links.effect: GPT-3 answered 62 questions correctly (failing score 289); GPT-4 answered 82 correctly (passing score 342); GPT-4 scored 65% on Imaging Technology in Bone Health.
links.quote: GPT-3 answered 62 questions correctly resulting in a failing ISCD score of 289. However, GPT-4 answered 82 questions correctly with a passing score of 342.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of GPT-3 and GPT-4 on a 100-question practice certification exam for clinical densitometrists without testing an organizational guardrail or deployment practice.
